mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially reducing indomethacin plasma concentrations, while NSAIDs may increase anticonvulsant levels and risk fluid retention affecting seizure control.
action: Monitor indomethacin efficacy and consider alternative analgesic/anticonvulsant combinations; ensure adequate renal function monitoring and maintain consistent NSAID dosing if used together.
